title: Cloud Security: monthly invoicing
content:
Cloud Security monthly invoicing is governed by these handling clauses.

## Handling basis

No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period.

Group service charges by invoice grouping dimensions.

Billing periods follow billing cycle in billing timezone, beginning at the first instant of the first date and ending exclusively at the first instant of the next month.

For measured usage, invoice only services whose interval has ended; lifecycle fees instead require their source occurrence to be completed; use the posted authoritative source records.

Set invoice issue time to the frozen handling time.

Carry forward a positive grouped subtotal below minimum positive monthly invoice amount rather than issuing an invoice; zero-rated usage stays visible as a meter and receives no monetary charge.

A source charge already posted for the same source event, meter, quantity component and invoice period is returned without another charge.

The fixed source reference and source subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable charge action, authoritative system records must establish: No posted charge exists for the same source event, meter, source subtype, pricing component and billing period. The evidence is bound to the same original source event reference.

## Basis Q&A

**How are distinct charge components identified?**

The fixed source reference and source subtype distinguish primary, supplemental, setup, termination, resumption and return-fee components.

## Invoice month boundary

Hypothetical case: a service instant is exactly the first instant of the next month. It is outside the preceding billing month, whose end is exclusive.
